items.question: What substances must continually fill that body in this ritual practice?
premises: Milk is indicated as a source substance.
Additional filling substances are to be used as means.
The prescribed action is to fill that body continually.
items.inference: Therefore the practitioner should always fill that body with milk and other filling substances.
uncertainties: The token '....' marks an unreadable or omitted portion of the text.
The exact form and analysis of 'kṣīrādā' are uncertain.
items.plain_english: One should always fill that body with milk and other such filling substances.
